Responsibilities

A oportunidade

Esta posição é responsável pela gestão dos motoristas de caminhão, administradores de frota e ativos veiculares da empresa, de forma padronizada para o Transporte, disseminando a estratégia de transporte definida pela empresa, alavancando a produtividade dos ativos, governando a operação dos motoristas de caminhão na direção econômica e defensiva, equilibrando custos e serviços, reduzindo o consumo de recursos naturais, melhorando o clima organizacional e apoiando a liderança da frota nas demandas diárias.

Seu Impacto

  • O principal objetivo desta posição é liderar a Área de Frota para garantir o melhor nível de serviço, equilibrando recursos humanos e ativos da frota própria da PepsiCo Alimentos, com as seguintes características (conflitantes entre si):
  • Liderar a equipe na rotina de transporte, distribuindo e monitorando tarefas;
  • Gestão de frotas e motoristas em operação;
  • Desenvolver planos de trabalho para identificar deficiências operacionais e funcionais;
  • Desenvolver um plano de carreira para seu direto, bem como avaliar desempenho e desenvolvimento;
  • Desenvolver procedimentos de trabalho e planos de manutenção de frotas;
  • Atender às necessidades de infraestrutura;
  • Garantir que as políticas de segurança do motorista e do veículo estejam alinhadas às diretrizes da empresa;
  • Garantir que os custos de transporte sejam lineares à composição do AOP e às variações do S&OP;
  • Fornecer à liderança da frota informações sobre a frota gerenciada;
  • Dimensionar os recursos de transporte de acordo com as diretrizes da empresa e a demanda necessária.
  • Gerenciar a estrutura de vendas de fretes em parceria com outras áreas interessadas da empresa e alguns parceiros externos. Garantir o aumento da receita de fretes por meio da expansão de novas oportunidades e coordenar as seguintes atividades:
  • Garantir o máximo desempenho integrando as rotas do Brasil, visando otimizar e aumentar a eficiência dos ativos, a sinergia entre todas as regiões e reduzir a quilometragem de veículos sem carga;
  • Minimizar a contratação de frete terceirizado e ampliar a disponibilidade e aderência do frete PEPLOG às demandas da Torre de Controle e do mercado, aumentando a aceitação de cargas de entrada;
  • Liderar a implementação e execução dos procedimentos de “Oferta de Fretes” ao mercado;
  • Responsável pelo pilar de manutenção da frota primária do Brasil

Qualifications

Quem estamos procurando?

  • Formação acadêmica: Graduado em Supply Chain, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma Inglês e Espanhol: intermediária
  • Conhecimento em transporte
  • Curiosidade pelo aprendizado
  • Desenvolvimento de Talentos
  • Confiança e Integridade
  • Inclusivo e Respeitoso
  • Colaboração
  • Liderança
  • Flexibilidade
  • Perspectivas externas
  • Tomando uma decisão
  • Pensamento avançado
  • Comunicação de Clareza

Se esta é uma oportunidade do seu interesse, encorajamos você a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar de nós:

  • Oportunidades de aprender e se desenvolver todos os dias por meio de uma ampla variedade de programas.

  • Programas de desenvolvimento de acordo com as competências de Liderança.
  • Treinamento especializado de acordo com a função.

  • Amamos celebrar o sucesso, por isso temos programas de reconhecimento por antiguidade, comportamento, liderança, momentos da vida, entre outros.
  • Programas de bem-estar financeiro que ajudarão você a atingir seus objetivos em todas as fases da vida.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que lhe permitirá equilibrar sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando sua jornada de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • E porque a sua família também é importante para nós, ela também pode desfrutar de benefícios como a nossa Linha Bem-Estar, milhares de Convênios e Descontos, Programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus filhos, Planos de Auxílio para diferentes momentos da vida, entre outros.

Somos uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais e valorizamos a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil, condição de veterano ou deficiência. title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
About the Role:

We are looking to add an energetic and self-motivated Senior Cloud Engineer to our high-performing global team of experts. This role involves architecting, implementing, and supporting cloud-based solutions that enhance the efficiency and reliability of our application services. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in various Cloud solutions, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and effective time and project management abilities to provide direction to the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement cloud solutions using best practices for tasks such as load balancing, service discovery, encryption, and application configuration.
  • Architect and support application services running in various cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP.
  • Implement, configure, and administer transactional email solutions using services like MessageBird and AWS SES.
  • Ensure familiarity with FedRAMP standards and maintain cloud security, including IAM policies, secret management, and KMS.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines in AWS, leveraging tools like AWS CloudFormation Templates.
  • Utilize JavaScript and Python for developing and enhancing cloud-based applications.
  • Integrate and manage CDN solutions, including CloudFront and Cloudflare, to optimize content delivery and website performance.
  • Implement and manage API gateway solutions such as Apigee and Kong to design, implement, and manage secure & efficient API solutions.
  • Familiarity with NGINX to optimize server performance and resource utilization.
  • Collaborate using GitHub and adhere to agile development frameworks.

About You:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Mandatory Skills: AWS, Azure, OCI, and GCP (At least any 2 cloud experiences, with AWS being mandatory).
  • Experience with MessageBird or Sparkpost and AWS SES (Mandatory).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and Python development.
  • Knowledge of CDN technologies, including CloudFront and Cloudflare, and their application in cloud environments.
  • Experience with API gateway solutions such as Apigee and Kong.
  • API gateway, API solution, API delivery network nice-to-have, DevOps, deployment experience.
  • Total Experience: 6+ years.
  • 4+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with a focus on application services, API management, and email solutions.
  • Proficient in architecting solutions across multiple cloud environments.
  • Experience with transactional email management and integration.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and collaboration tools like GitHub.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently under pressure.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Eager to learn, adapt to changing technologies, and lead by example in technical, personal, and corporate citizenship.

#LI-DD3

O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível (2-3 dias por semana no escritório, dependendo do papel) para funções baseadas em escritório, garantindo uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto presencial.

  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: ""Flex My Way"" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.

  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.

  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.

About DHL and Procurement: DHL Supply Chain is a global leader in logistics and supply chain management, committed to providing high-quality services and innovative solutions. Our Procurement team plays a crucial role in optimizing our supply chain processes and driving efficiency.

Job Purpose: As a Senior Data Engineer in the Data & Analytics Services Team, you will work on Data Lake and Data Warehousing projects, analyzing business and system requirements to define optimal data strategies.   • Coach a small team of junior data engineers (2 people).

  • University Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.

  • Expert programming skills in Python/PySpark; experience in Java/Scala is beneficial.
  • Experience with Data Warehousing for large complex datasets, including defining, building, and optimizing data models.
  • Expertise in implementing Data Lake/Big Data projects in Cloud MS Azure and/or On-premise platforms.
  • Experience with designing and building lakehouse architectures in Parquet/Delta and Synapse Serverless or Databricks SQL.
  • Working experience with DevOps frameworks and a strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle.
  • Experience in performing root cause analysis on data and processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate across different teams/geographies/stakeholders/levels of seniority.

  • Integração com Data Science: Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Data Science para projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em dados e Machine Learning.
  • Pipelines e processamento de dados: Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de ingestão, processamento e transformação de dados, garantindo qualidade, eficiência e governança.
  • Orquestração de Pipelines de Dados: Implementar e gerenciar workflows de dados utilizando ferramentas como Apache Airflow, garantindo a automação e escalabilidade dos processos de ingestão e processamento.
  • Melhores Práticas de DataOps: Aplicar conceitos de CI/CD para pipelines de dados, testes automatizados em ETLs, versionamento de dados e monitoramento contínuo da qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Segurança e Governança de Dados: Garantir boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos, auditoria e conformidade com regulamentos como LGPD e GDPR.
  • Boas práticas e escalabilidade: Atuar como referência técnica na implementação de soluções em nuvem, promovendo as melhores práticas de engenharia de dados, segurança, confiabilidade e escalabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Expertise em SQL: Domínio da linguagem SQL, incluindo melhores práticas, otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados eficiente.

  • Versionamento e colaboração: Conhecimento em sistemas de controle de versão, especialmente Git.
  • Integração e APIs: Familiaridade com consumo e criação de APIs para manipulação e integração de dados.
  • Processamento e análise de dados em larga escala: Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e tecnologias de Big Data para lidar com grandes volumes de dados.
  • Documentação e suporte: Capacidade de criar e manter documentações claras e acessíveis para facilitar o uso dos recursos por outros usuários.
  • Gerenciamento de projetos: Experiência com organização e entregas de projetos de alta complexidade em engenharia de dados.
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência com provedores de nuvem, com foco em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e serviços como Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow e Cloud Storage.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Data Science, incluindo bibliotecas e frameworks para modelagem e análise de dados.

title: TRADER ORIGINACAO E INSUMOS INTERIOR
description:
Descrição da empresa

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os nossos públicos. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Manter e aprimorar os relacionamentos comerciais com fornecedores e corretores do mercado de compra e venda de commodities;
  2. Acompanhar o mercado de compra e venda de commodities e também de fretes;
  3. Negociar a compra/venda de commodities com fornecedores/consumidores da região de atuação;
  4. Realizar operações de hedge (bolsa de Chicago e câmbio) nas compras ou vendas de commodities, assim como aferição de suas posições.

Qualificações

  1. Superior completo em Administração, Economia ou Agronomia;
  2. Conhecimento em Bolsa de Valores;
  3. Pacote Office;
  4. Power BI.

Informações adicionais

Disponibilidade para residir em Cuiabá-MT.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Esta oportunidade também é destinada às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

A Caio, empresa fabricante de ônibus, possui mais de 75 anos de história, aliando a tradição e experiência com a constante busca pela inovação. Estamos sempre na vanguarda, lançando produtos que ditam tendências e fazem a diferença na mobilidade urbana.

title: Research Assistant/Research Associate (Fixed Term)
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, motivated individual for a position in the group of Professor Alan Warren, Department of Hematology in the Cambridge Institute for Medical Research at the Cambridge Biomedical Campus. You will join an exciting research programme investigating fundamental mechanisms of ribosome assembly, translational control and how defects in these processes drive cancer development. This post will involve the use of cutting edge biochemical, proteomic, next generation sequencing and ribosome foot printing technologies.

This position is available for an immediate appointment. Candidates must either have a PhD in a relevant biological subject or have submitted or about to submit their PhD thesis. Candidates must also have demonstrable expertise in biochemistry, cell biology and/or molecular biology. Relevant post-doctoral experience is desirable. High quality peer-reviewed publications and a keen interest in translational regulation are essential.If you have an excellent background in biological sciences, are prepared to face intellectual challenges and wish to develop your scientific skills, we would like to hear from you. Applicants should have outstanding organisation and communication skills and work well as part of a team.

The Cambridge Institute for Medical Research (CIMR) is located on the Cambridge Biomedical Campus and it is a collaborative institute at the interface between fundamental research and the clinic, with a mission to determine the molecular mechanisms of disease in order to advance human health.

The funding for this position ends on 30th April 2030.

Applicants must have (or be close to obtaining) a PhD.

Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will initially be appointed as a ResearchAssistant (Grade 5, Point 36 £32,546) moving to Research Associate (Grade 7) upon confirmation of your PhD award

description:
Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99.Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo.

Role Responsibilities

  • O principal ponto de contato para nossos parceiros, garantindo uma comunicação próxima e contínua para gerar insights estratégicos, atender às suas necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação para crescimento e uma experiência aprimorada do usuário.
  • Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas.
  • Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.

Role Qualifications

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas.
  • 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo).

  • Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais.
  • Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação.
  • Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários.
  • Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.
  • Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.
  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.
  • Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

This position is based in Suape and the position is 100% based in the office.

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Analyst to act as the liaison between our operations teams and IT departments. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding both the technical aspects of our applications and the operational processes within the company. You will work to bridge the gap between these two areas, ensuring that operational requirements are translated into effective technical solutions and that support is provided to meet those needs. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual who thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Liaison Role: Serve as the key point of contact between operations teams and IT, ensuring clear communication and alignment on requirements, technical capabilities, and deliverables.
  • Application Understanding: Gain in-depth knowledge of the organization's applications and how they are used in day-to-day operations to ensure appropriate technical support and solutions.
  • Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with operations teams to understand business processes and user needs, and translate those into functional specifications for the IT department.
  • Process Mapping: Work closely with operational teams to map out processes, identify areas for improvement, and provide recommendations for process enhancements via technological solutions.
  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Assist with technical support issues by identifying the root cause, liaising with tech support groups, and coordinating the resolution of any technical problems impacting operations.
  • Project Coordination: Assist in managing and supporting IT projects aimed at improving operational efficiency, ensuring that timelines, budget constraints, and technical requirements are met.
  • Training & Documentation: Provide guidance and training to operations staff on the use of technology and applications. Develop and maintain documentation related to system processes, technical support guides, and operational workflows.
  • Collaboration with Tech Support: Work with IT teams to prioritize, track, and resolve technical issues and incidents impacting business processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for automation, system integration, or process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of both operations and IT support.

Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience:
    • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
    • 5+ years of experience in an IT Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role with exposure to both IT systems and business operations.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in business applications, systems, and software.
    • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, databases, and cloud technologies.
    • Familiarity with systems integration and data flow processes.
  • Operational Knowledge:
    • In-depth understanding of business processes and operations in a relevant industry (e.g., Stevedoring, shipping, logistics, etc.).
  • Communication & Collaboration:
    • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across both technical and operational teams.
  • Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills:
    • Ability to analyze operational needs and map them to technical solutions.
    • Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Project Management:
    • Experience with managing or supporting small to medium-scale IT projects, from planning through execution.

description:
Shape Your World

At Alcoa, you will become an essential part of our purpose: to turn raw potential into real progress. The way we see it, every Alcoan is a work-shaper, team-shaper, idea-shaper, world-shaper.

Esta é a sua oportunidade de ajudar a compartilhar o futuro da sustentabilidade com inovações que mudam o mundo e tecnologias de baixo carbono. Torne-se uma parte importante da equipe que está moldando o futuro do alumínio, revolucionando a maneira como o mundo vive, constrói, se move e progride. Faça parte disso e molde seu mundo.

Sobre a função:

O Engenheiro de Processo de Portos é o profissional responsável por garantir o adequado desenvolvimento de Indicadores e Metas de performance e melhoria de processos portuários através da aplicação de métodos analíticos e práticas de melhoria contínua. Atuando diretamente na obtenção de dados, sua lapidação e desenvolvendo estratégias de redução de perdas nos processos Operacionais.

  • Mapear os processos portuários segundo critérios de contorno, entrada e saída (Mapa de Fluxo de Valor – VSM);

  • Organizar e atualizar a base de dados operacionais seguindo a política e boas práticas de governança;

  • Definir as fontes de dados através de crítérios técnicos e realizar os devidos tratamentos estatísticos para posterior análise;

  • Desenvolver estrutura de Indicadores Chave (leading/Lagging) para os diferentes níveis de DMS ́s operacionais do Porto;

  • Garantir a governança de sistemas de gestão de perdas e liderar investigações operacionais ligadas a falhas de processo;

  • Garantir a governança da agenda ABS do terminal apoiando o Coordenador ABS local e os materiais de apoio às reuniões;

  • Suportar a gestão de custos da operação com dados adequados, interfaces objetivas e executar orçamentos;

  • Suportar a gestão de contratos da operação com indicadores financeiros e de produtividade bem como medições;

  • Criar e Manter layouts de Indicadores em ferramentas de Business Inteligence conforme padrões corporativos;

  • Promover ferramentas colaborativas de melhoria contínua na operação como Kaizens entre outros;

  • Atuar com foco em novas tecnologias identificando oportunidades de melhorias através da digitalização de processos;

  • Organizar as ações corretivas de não conformidades provenientes do processo em base digital e rastreável;

  • Gerir os procedimentos mantendo-os atualizados, didáticos, simples e intuitivos com uso de ferramentas Lean Manufacturing;

  • Criar e ministrar treinamentos operacionais para disseminar boas práticas de processos do porto;

  • Revisar anualmente os base lines de indicadores, analises SWOT e atualizar as metas através destes;

  • Realizar sempre que necessário análises estatísticas para compreensão de comportamentos de processos;

  • Liderar os fóruns técnicos anuais da companhia em interface as engenharias dos demais setores;

  • Realizar trade-offs financeiros de novas tecnologias, rotinas ou modus operandi na operação

O que você pode oferecer para a função:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharias;

  • Forte habilidade com dados, estatística e metodologias Lean Manufacturing (Green Belt e acima);

  • Experiência com ambiente industrial – turnos, conflitos, rotinas de reuniões, metas, procedimentos, treinamentos;

  • Capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos e colaboração entre diferentes áreas;

  • Didática para demonstração de resultados e tendencias através de dados;

  • Formação Black Belt (preferível) – Green Belt (mínimo)

  • Inglês Avançado.

  • Disponibilideade para residir em Sao Luis, MA.

O que está sendo oferecido:

  • Bônus anual relacionado ao desempenho (variável);

  • Academia Alcoa com treinamentos e planos de desenvolvimento robustos;

  • Programa Conte Comigo – assistência financeira, jurídica e psicológica

  • Reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo programa Great Place to Work;

  • Reconhecida pelo Guia Exame de Diversidade como uma das empresas com as melhores práticas relacionadas à inclusão, equidade, gênero, etnia, raça, pessoas com deficiências (PCDs) e pessoas LGBTQIA+

  • Destaque no Índice de Igualdade Corporativa de 2022 da Campanha de Direitos Humanos como uma das melhores empresas do Brasil para profissionais LGBTQIA+ com uma pontuação perfeita!

About the Location

The Alumar Consortium, managed by Alcoa, located 25 kilometers from the center of São Luís - MA, began its operations in 1984. It is made up of companies with a tradition in the areas of alumina and aluminum production, with different participations in the two factories that make up the Complex.

At Alcoa, we are committed to generating value in our relationships with all stakeholders in our business, communities and environment. We build inclusive and secure environments so that our people can live and express themselves as they please. With the aim of attracting and retaining diverse talent, the company maintains the inclusion groups that promote internal and external activities to value human diversity and plurality as a way of enriching one's own values.

title: Lead Quality Assurance Automation - Lyric Team
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Quality Assurance Automation – Lyric Team

You will start your day with a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goals with your team. Most of your day will be spent continuously evaluating existing test coverage, identifying gaps, and implementing test strategies to maximize confidence in automation and ensure product quality. Your role also involves advocating for necessary changes to improve the end-user experience.

In this role, you will collaborate with the development team and Product Owner to gather details on features to develop and use that information to build and execute product testing for ADP's web-based Human Resources solutions, ensuring usability before deployment. This role is critical to ensuring we deploy usable products.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience in:

  • Quality Assurance Analyst / Test Engineer
  • Selenium
  • Test Automation
  • Java, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • BDD/Cucumber
  • Jenkins
  • Writing Test Scenarios
  • Using API testing
  • Testing web UI and API applications
  • Working with Continuous Integration processes and tools like Jenkins

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Agile. You understand that an agile environment requires flexibility. Sometimes the scope is not fully defined, and you'll need to communicate with the Product Owner and team to gather more details and refine User Stories. You and the team will define the sprint goal together. Working in two-week sprints, you need to adhere to timelines. Due to time constraints and work fluidity, you may need to take a creative approach to testing strategies. Starting test development in parallel with feature development may be an option.
  • Create & Test. You'll define test plans and scenarios and implement automated test cases for large-scale, complex software applications, focusing on verification and validation from a system and end-user perspective.
  • Collaborate. You will communicate and collaborate with developers and stakeholders, articulating clear reasons to persuade for product improvements benefiting the end user.
  • Learning. You are eager to learn new coding skills and figure things out as you go.
  • Challenges. You will encounter challenges and will be expected to find solutions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

*The work model adopted by ADP is office-based/presential, with the possibility of up to two days of remote work per week.

Considering the activities involved in this role require access to highly confidential and sensitive information of ADP's clients and their employees, ADP reserves the right to conduct background checks periodically, as authorized by the Repetitive Resource Appeal nº 01 of the Superior Labor Court, with the candidate's/trabajador's consent.

title: Consultor Seguranca de Processos
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho, incluindo ética, integridade, humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Liderar o Processo de Implementação da Política de Segurança dos Processos na CIA

Desenvolver planos de implementação para atender aos padrões do programa PSP 2.0, incluindo:

  • Conformidade com o PSM da OSHA (29 CFR 1910.119);
  • Regulamentações locais de PSM + LDC PSP 2.0 para a prevenção de acidentes graves (eventos de magnitude significativa, como incêndios, explosões, derramamentos que podem causar fatalidades, impactar a mídia ou a reputação da empresa).

Garantir que as informações de segurança do processo (P&IDs, normas técnicas) sejam mantidas atualizadas, bem como as PHAs e suas conexões lógicas com o restante dos elementos do PSM e a tecnologia necessária para garantir operações seguras.

Fornecer suporte direto aos locais de fabricação sobre questões operacionais, sistemas ambientais e melhores práticas para implementação.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em engenharia ou áreas afins, com pós-graduação em Segurança de Processos.
  • Familiaridade com estudos de análise de riscos de processos (PHA), técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos, revisões pré-embarque (PSSR), gerenciamento de mudanças (MOC) e gerenciamento de contratados.
  • Conhecimento de planejamento, atividades de design, engenharia de projetos, operações e manutenção. Fluência em inglês. Conhecimento em softwares de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Experiência com instalações industriais com risco químico, gerenciamento de poeira em cereais, gás e petróleo ou riscos equivalentes, preferencialmente com foco na aplicação de um programa PSM.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Esta oportunidade também é destinada a pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro do nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados por criar valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para os stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nossos colaboradores, parceiros comerciais, comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for Sr. Analyst, Governance, Risk and Compliance. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Overview

As a GRC Sr Analyst – Policy Governance, you will be a key player in developing, implementing, and maintaining organizational governance frameworks and policies. You'll ensure compliance with internal regulations and external requirements, mitigate risks, and facilitate informed decision-making. This role requires a deep understanding of policy development, compliance monitoring, risk assessment, and stakeholder management. You will be a crucial part of ensuring the organization operates ethically, efficiently, and in accordance with best practices.

Essential Functions

  • Develop, implement, and maintain organizational governance frameworks and policies.
  • Develop metrics based on policies and standards.
  • Conduct regular reviews and updates of existing policies to ensure relevance and effectiveness.
  • Oversee policy development, monitor compliance, and maintain governance structures.
  • Facilitate decision-making processes related to governance and policy.
  • Conduct risk assessments for policy development and document mitigation strategies.
  • Provide guidance to project managers and teams on compliance matters.
  • Manage and distribute internal regulations such as policies, standards, and work procedures.
  • Assist staff with locating and interpreting organizational policies and procedures.
  • Support the governance process and policy development.
  • Communicate with the leadership team.
  • Identify and deliver opportunities for policy alignment, coordination, and collaboration.
  • Engage with the policy environment and persuade policymakers on the importance of various considerations.
  • Lead input to major policy and strategic projects from design to implementation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of work-related administrative experience.
  • Experience in policy development, implementation, and compliance monitoring.
  • Knowledge of governance frameworks, risk management, and compliance best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with online governance systems is a plus.
  • English fluent or in advanced level.

The Opportunity

As a Talent Attraction Manager, Assistant Director, you will oversee a dynamic team of Talent Attraction Recruiters, driving our mission to attract and retain the best talent for our organization.   4. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including business leaders and hiring managers, to understand their talent needs and deliver tailored recruitment solutions.
  5. Oversee talent pipeline process, collaborating with team members to identify top candidates and convert prospects into active applicants.
  6. Help drive the sourcing strategy to identify and attract diverse talent, ensuring the use of inclusive initiatives and creative sourcing techniques.
  7. Ensure a seamless and exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process, reinforcing EY's reputation for quality and innovation.
  8. Act as a change agent for new technologies, tools, and processes, facilitating their adoption within the recruiting community.
  9. Stay informed about talent and labor market trends, ensuring all recruiting activities comply with local legal and organizational policies and regulations.
  10. Leverage analytics and AI tools to gain insights into recruitment trends, candidate behaviors, and market demands, making informed decisions to optimize recruitment efforts.

  10. Capacity to thrive in a fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent projects.
  11. Strong reporting and data analytical skills.
  12. A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  13. Fluency in English, both verbal and written.

Why Join EY?

At EY, we are committed to building a better working world. In this leadership role, you will have the opportunity to help drive EY's talent acquisition efforts, guiding your team to attract the best candidates who align with our values and contribute to our success. You will be supported by a network of knowledgeable colleagues and have the chance to shape the future of our recruitment strategies in a dynamic and innovative environment. title: Competitive Intelligence Specialist
description:
The Competitive Intelligence Specialist is part of the sales team. Be prepared to work with the sales force to help win the deal. You will be THE expert on your competitor(s) and solely responsible for all insights and understanding of a competitor set and that responsibility does not end with educating the sales force on the competitor. You need to be prepared to present NetSuite vs. competitor X to our prospect, our partners and our systems integrators. You will be asked to compare our product with our competitor and answer deep functional differentiator questions. You will develop client-facing content and travel to client, prospect, partner and systems integrator meetings to add your knowledge and insight. While you will be building reusable content, the focus of this role is in support of deals which includes being comfortable with prospect and customer facing meetings and events.

You are also responsible for a vertical or horizontal business unit's market, competitor and customer insight needs. This includes providing insight support by using all primary and secondary resources available. You are considered a member of the sales force you support and will regularly be asked to participate in staff meetings, group sessions, deal reviews, partner interactions and client-facing competitor reviews. You own the win/loss review process and that includes interviewing the prospects and customers on why we won/lost and bringing that knowledge to bear in future sales cycles.

To do this you should have mastered all standard secondary resource tools and must be adept at engaging in primary research utilizing proven, validated research techniques. You will be seen as an expert in your area of responsibility and will regularly be asked for recommendations or opinions.

Career Level - IC4

Responsibilities

  1. Sales Lifecycle skills: Engages throughout the entire lifecycle of the deal from the initial “attract” phase through “close” providing content, collateral, talking points, FUD, traps, win themes, differentiators, and pricing strategy to beat the competitor. Support can take many forms including coaching the sales force to presenting directly to the prospect.
  2. Insight Generation skills: Proactively seeks additional analyses to flesh out findings. Integrates interesting patterns into a cohesive story. Maintains relationships with SMEs within the company and outside who can help with insight generation. Consistently informs research recommendations with a personal point of view. Uses professional experience to develop their own and their colleague’s recommendations. Consistently develops compelling "so what’s" and actionable "now what’s" for the business.
  3. Business problem solving skills: Reframes requests to maximize their value even when the requests come from difficult constituents. Continues the scoping conversation throughout the project process to test interim findings/insights with the business partner. Is recognized by senior business partners for possessing exceptional business acumen and is proactively sought for advice. Captures opportunities to influence business decisions and strategies consistently.
  4. Influencing skills: Focuses on relationship building as well as using strong scoping tools to uncover the problem even when not clearly articulated. Encourages debate around research recommendations and consistently advocates for their point of view.
  5. Communication skills: Capable of presenting point of view. Owns the building and constant updating of relationship maps to understand the appropriate constituents to focus on. Creates presentations that focus on the insights that are clearly articulated with supporting data where appropriate. Leverages knowledge management tools or research communications to share insights broadly across the organization, with a particular focus on vertical and industry communities. Considers communication preferences and decision maker needs to tailor recommendation communication across audiences. Presents at Voice of the Analyst events (when applicable) and/or other meetings.
  6. Synthesis skills: Takes ownership for stewarding the research team's knowledge base by continuously maintaining platforms on KM and/or collaboration platforms and other loci of knowledge. Works with business partners to compile current knowledge and identifies gaps that they need filled in order to make better decisions. Considered a valuable team member outside the research organization for their ability to compile and make sense of diverse data.
  7. Foundational skills: Seeks information on new techniques through conferences or other learning sources. Proposes new/different research techniques. Actively seeks out training in emerging methods and techniques. Seeks out sources and learning events to grow business acumen and industry knowledge.

description:
Description

This is a full-time, onsite, hourly position at our Bethlehem, PA facility.

Company Background:

ABEC is a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC's unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. ABEC's products include process and equipment engineering/consulting services, comprehensive site services, bioreactors and fermenters, filtration and chromatography systems, prep and hold systems, and cleaning/sterilization systems.

Benefits include:

  • Paid holidays and vacation time
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance (benefits start day 1)
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Generous 401K plan (40% match)
  • College tuition benefit program
  • Employee Referral Program

Position Summary:

The Mechanical Designer works under the direction of the Design Team Leader and utilizes independent judgment to perform the day-to-day project duties of designing, developing and releasing deliverables. This includes detail & assembly drawings and related bills-of-material used in the fabrication of equipment for pilot and commercial scale biopharmaceutical manufacturing (largely pressure vessel assemblies for fluid & gas handling and motorized agitation systems). Primary responsibility involves generating design plans utilizing Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD software. This position requires a high level of attention to detail along with the ability to develop a strong understanding of the ASME/ BPE Bioprocessing Equipment design standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Ability to work in a professional team-based office environment and meet date-driven customer-focused commitments.
  • Review and comprehend customer generated specifications and requirements.
  • Design and maintain documents with technical support from project engineering and project management.
  • Create / maintain component BOM documentation.
  • Create / maintain piping arrangement drawings (Top assembly and Piping module) using P&ID and customer specifications consisting of however not limited to, 3D models, detail drawings, spool drawings & bill of materials.
  • Create / maintain agitation system designs.
  • Generate Engineering Change Notices (ECN’s).
  • Create and maintain project files using departmental resources and best practices.
  • Conduct model design reviews with both internal resources as well as externally with customers and project management.
  • Record needed changes during design review processes and ensure they are communicated to the project team using departmental resources / best practices.
  • Provide manufacturing support related to published designs and released design documentation as required.
  • Generate “as-built” design documentation and provide to the Quality department as needed.
  • Will play an active role in identifying and driving Continuous Improvement (CI) opportunity.
  • Execute other tasks as assigned.
  • Ability to travel when required.

Qualifications:

  • Associates Degree in Computer Aided Design and Drafting or equivalent.
  • 1 year post graduate in drafting and design.
  • Knowledge of 3D Parametric CAD.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications; including Word and Excel.
  • Detail oriented with a solid understanding of drafting standards, design fundamentals, and related fabrication processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good organizational skills with the ability to multi-task.
  • Must work well both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining piping arrangement drawings (Top assembly and Piping module) with 3D models, spool drawings & bill of materials.
  • Generate Engineering Change Notices (ECN’s) used to properly document and publish control changes made to Design documentation as specified in company procedures, work instructions and best practices.
  • Domestic and international travel is required.
  • Awareness of and prior experience with implementing Continuous Improvement (CI) a plus.
  • Prior Lean/Six Sigma experience a plus.
  • Other work as assigned to support projects and/or customer expectations as needed.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Demonstrated ability to carry a project from conception to production.
  • 1-2 years in a related industry using 3D parametric CAD-based software with direct experience processing ECN’s, BOM’s and other related design documentation.
  • Prior experience using Autodesk Inventor and/or Routed Systems.
  • Prior experience using Autodesk AutoCAD 2D/3D.
  • Experience with ERP software for item and bill-of-material creation; Syteline preferred.
  • Experience with ASME/BPE Bioprocessing Equipment standards.
  • Awareness of and prior experience with implementing Continuous Improvement (CI) a plus.
  • Prior Lean/Six Sigma experience a plus.

title: Accounting Associate
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for an Accounting Associate!

Note to Applicants:

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Associate to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will assist in managing financial records, processing transactions, and supporting accounting functions to ensure smooth financial operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Accounts Payable:
    • The associate would be responsible for managing client email inboxes, including vendor information, responding to vendor emails, and coding invoices in the client’s accounts payable software daily. They would also prepare AP run files weekly.
  • Accounts Receivable:
    • Depending on the client, the associate would be responsible for preparing customer emails, sending collection follow-up emails, and preparing AR aging summaries.
  • Month End Close:
    • The associate will be working on 5-7 clients depending on their size, preparing month-end tasks concurrently during the first 10-15 business days of the month.
    • Tasks include bank and credit card reconciliations, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accounts payable and receivable reconciliations. As they gain experience, tasks can evolve in complexity, including payroll, accruals, revenue, and preparing financial statement packages and flux analysis.
  • Audit / Tax Requests:
    • As clients file annual tax returns or grow to need audits, associates will assist in preparing schedules needed to support these processes.

Requirements:

  • Strong preference for a degree in Accounting, with Finance or related fields being secondary.
  • If they have a degree in a related field, an accounting certification would be a plus.

Must Haves:

  • Full professional proficiency, both spoken and written. Effective communication is imperative.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role, preferably with a US-based company.
  • Experience preparing bank reconciliations, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, etc.
  • Experience with Quickbooks Online is a large bonus.

Nice to Haves:

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young).
  • Ability to create or improve processes in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Experience in Netsuite, Bill.com and/or Ramp.

Work Schedule:

Typically, the associate’s schedule would be 9AM - 6PM EST, with flexibility to shift that window an hour either way.

Perks:

  • Competitive USD compensation.
  • PTO Policy in addition to US Holiday Schedule.
  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing company.
  • Positive and collaborative work environment.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

Position Description Summary:
O Application Change Management System Engineer é responsável pela integridade geral do sistema e pela coordenação com outras equipes de suporte de TI para gerenciar mudanças nos sistemas dentro do escopo. Isso se aplica principalmente, mas não se limita, a sistemas SAP.

Detailed Description and Tasks Performed:
Este cargo inclui, mas não se limita, às seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Suporte à gestão de mudanças Follow The Sun (FTS) para todos os sistemas SAP, incluindo atividades de congelamento de mudanças e janelas de migração para o ambiente produtivo, atualizações SAP e atividades de atualização do sistema.
  • Uso de Solution Manager, SAP Change Request Management (ChaRM), Focused Build e SAP Transport Management System (STMS) para mover mudanças de aplicação através de mais de 30 ambientes de 3 camadas, bem como ambientes N+1.
  • Participação em uma equipe Ágil global.
  • Implementação e manutenção de controles de gestão de mudanças dentro dos sistemas SAP para garantir a integridade/disponibilidade do sistema.
  • Resolução de incidentes e problemas relacionados à gestão de mudanças em todos os ambientes SAP.
    Comunicação global diária com um grande número de equipes de processo e técnica.
  • Identificação e aproveitamento de oportunidades para tornar o suporte mais eficiente dentro das equipes.
  • Ponto de contato principal para equipes de processo, equipes técnicas e equipes de projeto na programação de mudanças para projetos e pequenas tarefas de trabalho, auxiliando na gestão de mudanças.
  • Disponibilidade para suporte fora do horário comercial (on-call), com cobertura de 3 regiões geográficas e suporte limitado nos finais de semana.
  • Participação no processo de recuperação de desastres (Disaster Recovery).

Através de diversas equipes, nosso trabalho de escritório se dedica a apoiar o negócio, criando e gerenciando processos que garantam o bom funcionamento organizacional. Promovemos a imagem corporativa, a gestão financeira eficiente, a conformidade regulatória e o bem-estar dos funcionários, entre outras áreas-chave. Junte-se a nós para contribuir para um ambiente empresarial próspero e bem organizado.

O que oferecemos?

  • Trabalhe com impacto: Ver pessoas todos os dias usando nossos trens, ônibus e ferrovias para chegar aos seus destinos nos enche de orgulho.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: A empresa promove um ambiente proativo, colaborativo e orientado para o trabalho em equipe, onde todos estão dispostos a ajudar a alcançar objetivos comuns.

Qual será a sua missão?

Contribuir com as atividades da área Contábil e Fiscal.

Quais serão as principais atividades?

  • Conciliações contas patrimoniais
  • Rotinas de fechamento contábil mensal (conferência NFs, contabilização folha de pagamentos, Apuração de impostos retidos, etc)
  • Apuração imposto de renda – Lucro Real
  • Preparação de Demonstrações Contábeis
  • Atendimento de auditoria
  • Lançamento de Notas Fiscais
  • Entrega de declarações (SPED Contribuições, SPED Contábil, ECF, IBGE)

O que fará você ter sucesso nesta posição?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Contabilidade, Ciências Econômicas ou Administração;
  • Três anos de experiência na função;
  • Domínio no Excel.

Quais são os benefícios oferecidos para esta posição?

  • Vale refeição ou restaurante no local
  • Vale alimentação
  • Assistência médica - estendido para cônjuge e filhos
  • Assistência odontológica- estendido para cônjuge e filhos
  • Seguro de vida
  • Auxílio creche - para mães de bebês até 18 meses
  • Parceria com universidades
  • Ambiente de trabalho com muito aprendizado e autonomia

Informações Importantes:

  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo (Itaim Bibi) ou Hortolândia -necessário residir próximo a um dos locais.

  • Regime de trabalho: Híbrido (2 dias de trabalho remoto por semana)

Acreditamos que cada funcionário contribui diretamente para o crescimento e sucesso da nossa empresa. Como uma equipe global com diferentes conhecimentos, formas de pensar e experiências variadas, queremos que cada funcionário sinta que pertence, está incluído e pode prosperar.

Como empresa socialmente responsável, incorporamos os princípios de Diversidade e Inclusão nas nossas práticas e incentivamos a igualdade de diferentes fontes para garantir um ambiente de trabalho aberto onde prevalecem o respeito mútuo e a igualdade de oportunidades.Somos um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais. We're searching for individuals who are long-time WordPress users who additionally know how to get their hands dirty when it comes to basic troubleshooting WordPress sites, and of course creating and customizing WordPress plugins and themes (bonus).

Self-starters that are independent, have incredible people skills, and are fluent in English are a requirement. Bar-tending or restaurant experience = bonus points. They make great support agents!

WHAT WE OFFER

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer:

  1. Competitive Local Salary.

  7. And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

LOCATION

This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Arizona, USA, so company operating hours are Monday - Friday, 8 am - 5 pm MST (UTC -7). Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment.

Your Impact:

The Equity One Delta Engineering Team at Goldman Sachs designs and maintains critical trading systems globally. With the Americas as the primary hub, the focus is on markets in the US, LatAm, and Canada. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and use AI and other cutting edges of technology.

As a developer on the Equity One Delta team, you'll be instrumental in building and refining both the user-facing and backend components of our trading systems, optimizing workflows for a range of equity services, from high-touch to low-touch execution. Your work will directly contribute to critical trading events like IPOs and index rebalances, ensuring a reliable and scalable infrastructure is in place to support these high-visibility activities.

This team is responsible for continuously evolving the platform architecture to meet the dynamic demands of various global business lines, emphasizing rapid and efficient software deployment. title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Your dream job! Customer Support at fun WordPress Startup

Do you dream of working for a startup that will help millions of people?

Do you have the heart of a teacher?

As a Customer Support (also known as “Happiness Engineer”), you will be responsible for keeping the wheels of a growing startup turning!

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • You’re a google spreadsheet wizard.
  • You’re amazing at following directions.
  • You’re passionate about research and helping people.
  • You’re incredibly organized and detailed.
  • You’re positive and enjoy making another person’s day.
  • You’re an excellent communicator who makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.
  • You’re a self-starter who loves taking initiative and seeing things through to completion.
  • You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow your skills.
  • You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work rather than just doing it to get it done.
  • You have prior WordPress experience and understand how plugins work, plugin and theme troubleshooting, etc.
  • You are a linguistic legend with a command of the English language so strong it would make Shakespeare bow down in awe.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You are the bridge between ApproveMe.com and our users. You are responsible for sales questions, general technical support, helping our users get to know the ins and outs of ApproveMe.com’s WP E-Signature plugin, and facilitating other tasks that are billing, user, or site-related.

Full Time or Part Time, we're searching for individual freelance contractors that are available for both. Our support team is a critical component of our organization... that is on the front-lines engaging with customers and potential customers each and every day.

We're searching for individuals who are long-time WordPress users who additionally know how to get their hands dirty when it comes to basic troubleshooting WordPress sites, and of course creating and customizing WordPress plugins and themes (bonus).

Self-starters that are independent, have incredible people skills, and are fluent in English are a requirement. Bar-tending or restaurant experience = bonus points. They make great support agents!

WHAT WE OFFER

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer:

  • Competitive Local Salary.
  • Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – the United States, Ireland, Bangladesh, India, Indonesia and more.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Custom branded laptop at your five year anniversary.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

LOCATION

This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Arizona, USA, so company operating hours are Monday - Friday, 8 am - 5pm MST (UTC -7). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day. If we need to sync up in real-time before you work on your project/tasks.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Personal Computer with (reliable) Internet Access
  • Availability to participate in (bi-weekly) audio/video meetings between the hours 8 am - 5 pm PST
  • Available for 40+ hours per week (this is a full-time position)

HOW TO APPLY

If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Please clearly include the following in your cover letter:

Tell us a bit about yourself and why you should be considered. Include any details about your experience, qualifications, personality, etc. that are relevant to the job posting.
We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly. Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a test assignment.
Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT APPROVEME.COM

ApproveMe.com is a startup located in Phoenix, AZ. Our product WPESign transforms a WordPress powered website into a legally binding, court recognized document signing application. We’ve been collaborating with some of the most successful designers and startups founders in the world to create a new product that will literally change how the electronic signature industry approaches signing documents forever.

title: Analista Comercial Junior
description:
O Analista Comercial é um profissional que trabalha no suporte às operações comerciais, ajudando a equipe comercial a alcançar os objetivos da empresa. Sua principal função é analisar e processar dados, gerenciar informações sobre o mercado e clientes, além de fornecer suporte estratégico para a tomada de decisões dentro da área comercial. Esse cargo exige habilidades analíticas, organizacionais e de comunicação, além de um bom entendimento dos processos comerciais.
Principais responsabilidades:

  • Análise de Mercado e Desempenho Comercial:
    • Coletar, processar e analisar dados de vendas, tendências de mercado, concorrência e comportamento dos clientes.
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos para monitorar o desempenho das vendas, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e sugerir ações estratégicas.
    • Realizar a análise de indicadores comerciais (KPIs), como taxa de conversão, ticket médio, ciclo de vendas, entre outros.
  • Suporte na Planejamento Comercial:
    • Apoiar na elaboração de planos e estratégias comerciais, colaborando com as equipes de vendas e marketing.
    • Ajudar a definir metas de vendas, estratégias de precificação e segmentação de mercado.
    • Acompanhar a execução das estratégias e reportar resultados e desvios aos gestores.
  • Gestão de Relacionamento com Clientes:
    • Apoiar a equipe comercial na identificação de clientes potenciais e manter o banco de dados de clientes atualizado.
    • Auxiliar na manutenção do relacionamento com os clientes através de ferramentas de CRM (Customer Relationship Management).
    • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de propostas comerciais e no processo de negociação.
  • Processamento e Controle de Pedidos e Contratos:
    • Ajudar na elaboração e controle de pedidos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos, garantindo que os processos sejam feitos corretamente.
    • Monitorar o andamento dos pedidos e garantir que as entregas e o processo de faturamento sejam realizados de maneira eficiente.
  • Monitoramento de Competência e Mercado:
    • Realizar pesquisas sobre as tendências do mercado, comportamento dos consumidores e concorrência para fornecer informações cruciais à estratégia comercial.
    • Auxiliar na análise da performance de produtos e serviços da empresa em comparação com os oferecidos pelos concorrentes.
  • Apoio à Equipe Comercial:
    • Fornecer suporte operacional à equipe de vendas, seja com informações sobre clientes, produtos, preços ou demais dados necessários para a prospecção de novos negócios.
    • Preparar apresentações comerciais e materiais de apoio para reuniões com clientes ou reuniões internas.

title: Bid Manager (Coordenador Senior de Propostas)
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the Bid Manager in São Paulo we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in bids and signalling systems to a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and goal-oriented teammates.

You'll play a key role in driving successful bid management processes, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and Alstom’s strategic goals. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, finance, legal, and procurement), manage risk assessments, and ensure adherence to deadlines, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of leading national and international bids and developing strategies for the transportation and information markets, but also liaise with multicultural and matrix teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

We’ll look to you for:

  • Managing bids for signalling systems in the rail market

  • Ensuring alignment with customer expectations, technology breakthroughs, and competitive landscapes

  • Driving financial results and ensuring cost-effective solutions

  • Conducting risk analysis (financial, legal, and political) and implementing mitigation strategies

  • Collaborating with internal and external partners to motivate and achieve results

  • Ensuring adherence to deadlines while maintaining quality and rigor


All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

  • Engineering Degree (Master equivalent or above) in Telecom, Electrical, Electronics, or Automation

  • More than 8 years of experience as a bid manager

  • Experience in signalling systems within the rail market

  • Knowledge of transportation and information markets, including customer expectations and business models

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills

  • Experience in risk analysis methods

  • Understanding of technical/engineering issues, contracting, finance, and product specifications

  • Fluency in English; Spanish advanced

  • Effective active listening, communication, and negotiation skills

  • Ability to work in a multi-cultural and matrix organization

  • Focus on simple solutions to complex problems

  • Strong process orientation and financial result-driven mindset


Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

  • Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career

  • Work with advanced security standards for rail signalling

  • Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

  • Contribute to innovative projects

  • Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment

  • Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

  • Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

  • Progress towards senior leadership roles

  • Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Senior brand designer analyst
description:
About Azion

We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About the position

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Brand Designer Analyst to join our marketing team. As a technical B2B company, we need someone who understands how to communicate complex ideas visually, shaping and evolving our brand identity to resonate with developers, enterprise customers, and industry leaders. You will be key in crafting compelling brand experiences across digital and physical touchpoints, ensuring brand consistency while driving engagement and awareness.

Main challenges

  • Lead and evolve Azions brand identity, ensuring a cohesive and compelling visual presence across all channels;
  • Design assets for events, presentations, websites, whitepapers, blogs, digital ads, and marketing campaigns, maintaining high design excellence;
  • Collaborate closely with product marketing, product, content, and demand generation teams to create impactful visual storytelling;
  • Oversee the design and execution of branded materials for industry conferences, webinars, and customer events;
  • Work with external agencies and freelancers when needed to scale design efforts.

Ideal Profile

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into visually engaging designs;
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions;
  • A self-starter with strong time management skills and attention to detail.

Requirements

  • Consolidated experience in brand design, ideally within a B2B technology or SaaS environment;
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color theory, and composition;
  • A strong portfolio showcasing brand identity, digital campaigns, event design, and presentation design;
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects), and other industry-standard design tools;
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including marketers, developers, and external vendors;
  • Experience designing for web, digital advertising, events and social media.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in motion design and video editing;
  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS is a plus.

Benefits and Azion Way of Life

  • CLT hiring model;

  • Health and dental plan;

  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;

  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;

  • Annual internal hackathons;

  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);

  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);

  • Platform for language courses (English and Spanish);

  • Stock options (according to policy);

  • Birthday day off;

  • TotalPass;

  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);

  • Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;

  • Annual international exchange program.

FlexWork Model

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Submit your portfolio or include a link to it in your application, so we can get to know your skills and design approach better!

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!
